TheHGTech Threat Intelligence Platform provides real-time monitoring of malicious indicators of compromise (IOCs) across multiple trusted feeds. Updated every 4 hours.

Track active ransomware campaigns, malicious IPs, phishing domains, and emerging malware hashes before they breach your network perimeter.

Automated Data Collection & Retention Policy

Data Source: Automatically aggregated from 9 trusted security vendors (OpenPhish, Malware Bazaar, Spamhaus, CINS Army, Blocklist.de, URLhaus, ThreatFox, Feodo Tracker, SSL Blacklist)

Update Frequency: Every 4 hours via automated collection
Retention Period: 7 days from first appearance
Auto-Pruning: IOCs older than 7 days are automatically removed

All data is collected automatically without manual intervention. Timestamps indicate when each IOC was first detected, not when it was last updated. This enables meaningful time-based analysis while maintaining data freshness and manageable file sizes.

Methodology & Data Sources

We aggregate open-source intelligence from industry-leading security vendors. Our engine deduplicates, normalizes, and enriches this data with AI analysis to provide actionable insights.

9+ Trusted Feeds

We ingest raw data from OpenPhish, URLhaus, ThreatFox, Malware Bazaar, Spamhaus DROP, CINS Army, Blocklist.de, and more. All feeds are updated every 4 hours.

AI Enrichment

Our local LLM analyzes patterns in the data to generate daily threat briefings and identify emerging campaigns that rule-based systems might miss.

MITRE Mapped

Where possible, indicators are mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, helping defenders understand the TTPs behind the attacks and improve detection rules.
